name: dynamic-island-shell
description: Floating or bezel-flush dynamic island HUD shell with concave fillet notch ears and smooth morphing between idle pill, compact activity, and expanded card states.

visual_references.name: Apple Dynamic Island
visual_references.purpose: smooth morphing pill between compact activity badge and expanded card

visual_references.name: macOS Notch HUD
visual_references.purpose: bezel-flush top screen attachment with concave inverted fillet ears

design_constraints: No hardcoded device logos or application-specific transfer logic
Flexible container slots for idle, compact, and expanded views

source_provenance.neutralization_summary: Extracted top-bezel flush Dynamic Island HUD shell with concave fillet ears and multi-state geometry morphing. Removed AirLink file transfer and pairing logic in favor of generic slots.
